doors.note: Brand trades as Rene Ruiz Collection. 'Our Boutiques' lists 5 open boutiques (Manhasset NY, Coral Gables, Boca Raton, Hallandale Beach, Naples FL; appointment booking offered but listed with walk-in hours) + Livingston NJ COMING SOON. Naples ZIP: visit-us page says 34102, store-locator page says 34012 — used 34102.

craft_evidence.owned: no — company stores (Manhasset NY; Boca Raton, Hallandale, Coral Gables FL) are retail; no workroom or factory named (/pages/our-story)
craft_evidence.mills: none — 'Italian brocades' in site copy, fabrics chosen 'at the Premiere Vision fabric show in Paris'; no mill named
craft_evidence.madein: 0 of 81 state a country; 1 of 758 product descriptions says 'Imported'
craft_evidence.heritage: 'the 30-year-old Miami brand'; owner Brad Rosenblatt took ownership in 2009 (/pages/our-story)
craft_evidence.process: partial — 'hand draped' / 'hand-draped' in ~150 product descriptions, 'hand-sewn' 9, 'hand beaded' 2; 'made to order, 4–6 / 8 week delivery' on gowns; no place or maker
craft_evidence.reasoning: Hand-draping and made-to-order gowns are described across the range and the house is dated (Miami, ~30 years), but no workroom, maker, mill or country is named anywhere. Same footing as Camilla in batch 07: process claims without a verifiable place — 2.
